verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a self-hosted Edge Proxy service that runs the Flagsmith Engine within your own infrastructure and is connected to directly by server-side SDKs, keeping evaluation traffic local and resilient to vendor outages. This directly matches the platform-engineer story of running a relay/edge proxy for network-local flag serving. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of failover behavior when the vendor API is unreachable, and more detail on sync/refresh mechanics between proxy and main API.
